event.description: Tie the fourth-closest positional scalar pair
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,115 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 7 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0064, the third positional scalar tie at 2,115 parameters and unchanged 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034. Recomputing over the 509 retained positional groups identifies representatives 49 and 125 as closest, with values -0.0000943496 and -0.0000932168, differing by 1.133e-6. Hypothesis: sharing their mean cumulatively preserves qualification and yields 2,114 parameters. This is more informative than any other untested pair because it is the current minimum-distortion union after all retained merges.
